Hi {{firstName}},

In case our earlier note to your colleague {{colleague_name}} did not reach the right desk, we wanted to share it with you as well.

{{personal_line}}

Would a brief 10-minute call with our outreach lead work for you at a time of your convenience?

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
Diablo Sugar Free (B Healthy Ltd, London)


We found your business details in public and commercial sources. If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again.

Privacy notice: {{privacy_url}}
